svg.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal;

title.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal;

svg.title: 手记 AI 操作的主要迁移

desc.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-dasharray: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; text-anchor: start; paint-order: normal;

svg.desc: pending 经 发起 到 running；running 经 收到 到 received；received 经 确认 到 saved；running 经 未确认 到 unknown；unknown 经 查询原结果 到 received；running 经 明确失败 到 failed；failed 经 放弃 到 abandoned。unknown 查询原请求，不重复生成；saved / abandoned 是终态，旧返回不能复活。
